extracted.intended_audience: readers and librarians seeking the Best American Short Stories anthology (general public interested in contemporary short fiction)
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the editorial selection process for The Best American series: the series editor surveys periodicals to find notable works, and a guest editor (a leading writer) selects roughly twenty pieces for the annual volume.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series editor selects notable works from periodicals
rubrics_metrics.description: Each volume's series editor selects notable works from hundreds of periodicals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied guidance: the series editor surveys a wide range of magazines and journals to compile a longlist of notable short fiction and nonfiction pieces published in periodicals prior to the volume; no explicit scoring rubric or further selection criteria are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest editor chooses the best ~20 pieces
rubrics_metrics.description: A special guest editor, a leading writer in the field, then chooses the best twenty or so pieces to publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied guidance: the guest editor exercises final judgment to pare the series editor's selections to approximately twenty pieces for inclusion; the guest editor's stature and literary judgment are central to the final selection. No detailed evaluation criteria (e.g., theme, craft elements) are specified on the page.
